name: hijri_gregorian_conversion
title: Hijri and Gregorian Calendar Conversion
summary: A capability to convert dates between the Islamic lunar Hijri calendar and the Gregorian calendar, providing localized month and day names, and metadata about month and year lengths.

tools.name: convert_hijri_to_gregorian
tools.description: Converts a Hijri date to its corresponding Gregorian date.

params.name: hijri_date_iso
params.description: The Hijri date: YYYY-MM-DD with the month as a number (e.g. 1418-10-02), or day, month name and year as written (e.g. '2 Shawwal 1418'). Prefer the month name when the question gives one.

returns.name: gregorian_date_iso
returns.description: The converted Gregorian date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

returns.name: display_date
returns.description: A human-readable Gregorian date string in DD/MM/YYYY format.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Parse the input 'hijri_date_iso' using 'hijridate.convert.Hijri.fromisoformat'. 2. Call '.to_gregorian()' on the resulting Hijri object. 3. Extract components using '.isoformat()' and '.datetuple()' from the Gregorian object.

tools.name: convert_gregorian_to_hijri
tools.description: Converts a Gregorian date to its corresponding Hijri date.

params.name: gregorian_date_iso
params.description: The Gregorian date in ISO format (YYYY-YYYY-MM-DD).

returns.name: hijri_date_iso
returns.description: The converted Hijri date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

returns.name: display_date
returns.description: A human-readable Hijri date string in DD/MM/YYYY format.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Parse the input 'gregorian_date_iso' using 'hijridate.convert.Gregorian' constructor with parts split from the string. 2. Call '.to_hijri()' on the resulting Gregorian object. 3. Extract components using '.isoformat()' and '.datetuple()' from the Hijri object.

tools.name: get_hijri_date_properties
tools.description: Provides detailed information about a specific Hijri date, including its localized names, weekday, and month/year lengths.

params.name: hijri_date_iso
params.description: The Hijri date: YYYY-MM-DD with the month as a number (e.g. 1418-10-02), or day, month name and year as written (e.g. '2 Shawwal 1418'). Prefer the month name when the question gives one.

params.name: language_code
params.description: The two-letter language code for localization (e.g., 'en', 'tr').

returns.name: weekday_index
returns.description: The day of the week index (0=Monday, 6=Sunday).

returns.name: isoweekday_index
returns.description: The day of the week index (1=Monday, 7=Sunday).

returns.name: year_length_days
returns.description: The number of days in the Hijri year.

returns.name: month_length_days
returns.description: The number of days in the Hijri month.

tools.implementation_notes: 1. Parse input 'hijri_date_iso' using 'hijridate.convert.Hijri.fromisoformat'. 2. Call '.month_name(language)', '.day_name(language)', '.weekday()', '.isoweekday()', '.year_length()', '.month_length()', and '.notation(language)' on the Hijri object.

uncertainties: The exact range of supported Hijri years is determined by the library's internal validation logic; users should provide valid Hijri dates.
